source_name: Portál gov.cz — Změna zápisu v obchodním rejstříku (service description)
why_relevant: Authoritative procedural description of how and when a change of registered particulars must be filed ('bez zbytečného odkladu'), which forms (inteligentní formuláře) are used and which court is competent. Needed to calibrate the expected lag between a real-world leadership move and its register appearance — essential for dating claims correctly.

source_name: LinkedIn profile - Kamila Šimonová (board member responsible for product development, insurer)
why_relevant: Surfaced directly by the Czech phrase 'nastupuji do' — a worked example that this exact self-announcement idiom is indexed and retrievable, and a bancassurance-adjacent move worth tracking.

source_name: PSE – Konsolidovaná výroční zpráva BCPP (exchange annual report)
why_relevant: Gives the authoritative annual list of issuers admitted to the Prime/Standard markets — the population definition needed to enumerate which banking/payment issuers this cell must monitor, and it also documents the exchange's own governance/disclosure infrastructure.

source_name: Měšec.cz — bank employer/benefits and employee-rating features
why_relevant: Consumer-finance outlet that periodically synthesises employee ratings and benefits across CZ banks — a ready-made cross-bank comparison and a pointer back to the underlying review platforms; its comment threads also carry employee voice.

source_name: MPSV — Příručka pro personální agendu (ppropo.mpsv.cz), section on hromadné propouštění
why_relevant: Authoritative statement of the legal procedure: thresholds, who must be notified, what must be reported to the ÚP and to the union/works council, and timing. Defines exactly which paper trail exists and when — essential for knowing what to look for and when a restructuring becomes legally visible.

source_name: ABSL Czech Republic — Business Services Sector reports
why_relevant: Annual sector report quantifies centres and headcount by city (Prague, Brno, Ostrava, Hradec Králové, Liberec) and by function; the single best baseline for judging whether a bank's regional hiring is normal or exceptional, and a pointer to named centre operators.

source_name: AmCham Czech Republic — EU Transparency Register / LobbyFacts datacard
why_relevant: Transparency-register filings disclose the chamber's declared staff, lobbyist headcount, budget and named representatives — an independent, structured cross-check on chamber personnel that the chamber's own site may not publish.

source_name: BusinessInfo.cz — návody: zápis do obchodního rejstříku / veřejné rejstříky
why_relevant: State-backed business-information portal explaining exactly which documents must go into the Sbírka listin and which facts must be registered. Serves as the taxonomy reference for building an extraction schema for filed documents (what document types exist and what each implies about org change).

source_name: TalentUp — Czech Republic salary benchmark report
why_relevant: Free CZ benchmark covering 110+ roles across 12 departments incl. Finance, banded by seniority and company type; a non-recruiter cross-check on recruiter-published bands.

source_name: Temenos — Success Stories & Press Releases (Komerční banka)
why_relevant: Direct evidence of a CZ systemic bank's core-banking replacement that never appears in a public procurement portal. Temenos press releases name the bank, the implementation partners (Syncordis, LTIMindtree), the tech stack (private cloud, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL) and the migration timetable — i.e. the shape and duration of demand at KB.

source_name: Zákoník práce č. 262/2006 Sb. — Díl 6 Hromadné propouštění; Část dvanáctá (informování a projednání, rada zaměstnanců)
why_relevant: The statute itself: defines mass redundancy thresholds and the mandatory information/consultation duties toward the union organisation, works council (rada zaměstnanců, 3–15 elected members) and the Labour Office. Legal anchor for every other source in this cell.
